$ aws-login 
--- stdout

identity:   arn:aws:sts::000000000000:assumed-role/Stub/user
signed in:  <time> (by aws-login)
ends:       ~<time> — past the 8-hour limit; the role credentials still work until they expire, the next refresh will not
run 'aws-login planlab-prod --renew' to sign out and start a new 8-hour session
